profile.summary: Modi Naturals Limited, together with its subsidiary, Modi Biotech Private Limited, engages in the manufacture and marketing of oils and deoiled cakes in India. It operates through Branded Business and Bulk Business segments. The company provides healthy olive oil and rice bran oil blend under the Oleev Olive oil and Oleev Active oil brands; multisource oil under Oleev Health Oil and Oleev Smart Oi
